steps.title: Prepare overnight preculture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 200 mL LB medium containing 1× kanamycin and grow overnight as a preculture.

steps.title: Inoculate main culture and grow
steps.instruction: Transfer the 200 mL preculture into 2 L LB medium containing 1× kanamycin, grow at 37 °C with shaking until the optical density reaches 0.8–1.0.

substeps.instruction: Take a 1 mL sample for SDS‑PAGE analysis before induction.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Cool the culture on ice to room temperature, add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.5 mM, and incubate for 4 h at 20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Take a 1 mL sample for SDS‑PAGE analysis after induction.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Spin down the culture at 4000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and resuspend the cell pellet in 20 mL lysis buffer (including the additional components listed in the buffer composition section).

substeps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the suspension and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Lyse cells
steps.instruction: Thaw the frozen cell suspension on ice, add any additional components specified for the lysis buffer, and sonicate on ice 6 × 30 s with 30 s pauses between pulses.

substeps.instruction: Check lysate viscosity and take a sample for SDS‑PAGE.
Centrifuge the lysate at 15 000 rpm for 30 min (temperature not specified, keep on ice).
Collect the cleared supernatant (SN) for purification and keep pellet and SN samples for SDS‑PAGE.

steps.title: Prepare Ni‑affinity column
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL His‑Select Ni affinity gel (capacity up to 15 mg/mL) to a disposable column.

substeps.instruction: Wash the gel with 10 mL AD buffer.
Equilibrate the column with 20 mL wash buffer (discard flow‑through).

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Apply the cleared lysate to the Ni column at a slow flow rate (use a needle if necessary), retaining the flow‑through and taking a sample for gel analysis.

steps.title: Wash bound protein
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 20 mL wash buffer at a higher flow rate, retain the flow‑through and take a sample for gel analysis.

steps.title: Elute target protein
steps.instruction: Elute with 12 mL elution buffer, collecting 1 mL fractions at a slow flow rate; keep the sepharose and take samples of each fraction for gel analysis.

steps.title: Analyze samples by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load the following samples on an SDS‑PAGE gel: non‑induced culture, induced culture, whole lysate, pellet, supernatant, flow‑through, wash fractions, sepharose, and elution fractions.

steps.title: Pool peak fractions and dialyze
steps.instruction: Identify peak fractions on the gel, pool them, and either dialyze overnight against 100× dialysis buffer or use a PD‑10 desalting column.

steps.title: Determine protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of the pooled protein using Bradford reagent and/or UV absorbance (ε₂₈₀ values: Hia5 = 43 110 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹, EcoGI = 72 225 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹, Btr192V = 50 100 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹, Hin1523 = 44 600 M⁻¹ cm⁻¹).

steps.title: Store purified protein
steps.instruction: Aliquot the purified protein and store at –80 °C (or –20 °C for short‑term use).
